text: A standard ESN requires a stable reservoir (spectral radius < 1), but FORCE can train a chaotic reservoir with spectral radius > 1.
explanation: The FORCE-vs-ESN comparison states standard ESN readout training assumes rho < 1, while FORCE works on chaotic reservoirs (the lab uses rho = 1.2; Sussillo & Abbott used 1.5), harnessing their rich dynamics.
